races.display_title: Donohue Marquees Risk Of Thunder Chase
races.verdict: STUMPTOWN is a very smart performer in cross-country events, winning 5 times including this race, at the Cheltenham Festival and the historic Velka Pardubicka, and he looks to hold strong claims after reappearing with a victory over hurdles. The biggest threat could come from Fountain House , while The Goffer is also considered. STUMPTOWN (IRE) FOUNTAIN HOUSE (IRE) THE GOFFER (IRE)
races.betting_forecast: Stumptown (13/8), Desertmore House (6/1), Fountain House (7/1), Busselton (8/1), Outside The Door (8/1), The Goffer (10/1), Fakir D'Oudairies (10/1), The Short Go (12/1), Thatildojon (14/1), Union Station (20/1), Idy Wood (20/1), Caesar Rock (25/1), Three By Two (33/1), The Gallan (66/1), Fr Gilligansvoyge (100/1)

races.display_title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict: A competitive affair which can go the way of MARIA DA SILVA , who deserves credit for overcoming a pace bias at Kempton late last month. Eazy On The Eye backed up her Epsom win with a good effort at Newmarket and she should remain competitive from the same mark, whilst bottom-weight Cixi was better than the result at Kempton last time and also merits consideration. MARIA DA SILVA (IRE) EAZY ON THE EYE CIXI (USA)

races.verdict: WELLWHATSHAPPENIN has made a positive start for current connections and ran well when second at Chelmsford 17 days ago, so he's taken to build on that effort here. Poke The Bear has bagged 3 wins at this track and is now 3 lb below his last winning mark so looks the biggest danger. Electric Bass is one of several others with place claims. races.display_title: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap
races.verdict: AUTUMN'S BREEZE needs to brush up on her starts but a change in headgear may help on that score and she now finds herself back down in 0-65 company so could prove good enough in a trappy contest. Notable Charm has been shaping well and is one to take seriously up against older horses, while Chilli King is only just finding his feet and should improve further for the step up to 2m. AUTUMN'S BREEZE (IRE) NOTABLE CHARM CHILLI KING
races.betting_forecast: Notable Charm (5/2), Noble Grace (9/2), Calshot Spit (11/2), In The Post (11/2), Chilli King (15/2), Snapius (15/2), Autumn's Breeze (10/1), State Express (16/1), Little Peter (33/1)

races.display_title: William Hill Challenge Series Irish EBF Beginners Chase
races.verdict: ROSIE'S WINGS may well have made a successful chasing debut had he not made a late mistake at Fairyhouse recently, so Ross O'Sullivan's 6-y-o earns the vote to go one better with improvement likely. Having finished runner-up on sole start in points, Kaiser de Chanay heads up the dangers on chasing bow back from 7 months off, with Some Song and Speculateur another couple worth considering, too. ROSIE'S WINGS (IRE) KAISER DE CHANAY (FR) SOME SONG (IRE)
